RawTokenLexer returns tokens in wrong order

#### Description

The RawTokenLexer is returning tokens with value and token type swapped. When processing raw token data, the lexer yields `(value, token)` instead of the expected `(token, value)` tuple format.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pygments import highlight
from pygments.lexers import PythonLexer
from pygments.lexers.special import RawTokenLexer
from pygments.formatters import RawTokenFormatter

code = '2 + α'
raw = highlight(code, PythonLexer(), RawTokenFormatter())
tokens = list(RawTokenLexer().get_tokens(raw.decode()))
print("Expected format: (token_type, value)")
print("Actual output:", tokens[0])
```

The lexer should return tuples in the format `(token_type, value)` but instead returns `(value, token_type)`.
</issue>
